skill.name: share-skill
skill.description: Share and version local Claude skills by migrating them into a git repository with optional remote setup and docs generation.
skill.summary: Migrate local Claude skills into a repository, add git tracking, configure remotes, and generate documentation pages.
skill.author: guo-yu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation or localization false positives from examples for git remotes, Claude config paths, shell snippets, and generated documentation links. The material risk is that the skill asks users to grant broad Claude Code shell permissions and performs symlink-based migration of active skill directories. Static review was capped at 400/825 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 425 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Replace wildcard permissions with the narrowest command patterns possible and require confirmation for git, move, symlink, and settings writes.

remediation.issue: Symlink migration affects active skill loading
remediation.suggestion: Validate skill names and target paths, show resolved paths before execution, and refuse paths outside the configured skills repository.

remediation.issue: Local config may contain repository and account details
remediation.suggestion: Avoid printing full configuration by default and redact remote URLs or account identifiers where possible.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Claude Code Permission Allowlist

content.value_statement: Local Claude skills are hard to version, publish, and reuse across machines. This skill guides migration into a repository, configures remotes, and generates documentation for sharing.
actual_capabilities: Finds local skills under the Claude skills directory and prepares them for repository storage.
Moves a selected skill into a configured skills repository and links it back for local use.
Initializes git tracking, creates ignore rules, and supports remote alias configuration.
Lists available local skills and configured remote targets.
Generates a static documentation website for shared skills with optional style settings.
limitations: Requires local filesystem and git command access to migrate skills.
Can modify Claude configuration and skill directories, so users should review commands before running them.
Remote publishing depends on the user having valid git credentials and repository permissions.
Documentation generation uses templates and may need manual review before publication.

use_cases.title: Publish a personal skill
use_cases.description: Move a local Claude skill into a git repository and prepare it for open source release.

use_cases.title: Standardize team skill storage
use_cases.description: Keep team-authored skills in one repository with consistent git history and documentation.

use_cases.title: Build a skill documentation site
use_cases.description: Generate a static site that lists skills and links to localized documentation.

prompt_templates.title: List local skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share-skill to list the local skills that can be migrated.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate one skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share-skill to migrate my local skill named <skill-name> into my configured skills repository.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a remote alias
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share-skill to add a remote alias named github for my skills repository, then show the configured remotes.

prompt_templates.title: Publish with documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use share-skill to migrate <skill-name>, configure the remote, generate the documentation site, and explain each command before running it.

output_examples.output: The assistant reports detected local skills, shows their paths, and identifies which ones are already linked.
The assistant confirms the source skill, target repository path, created link, git initialization, and next publishing steps.

output_examples.input: Generate documentation for the skills repository.
output_examples.output: The assistant describes the generated documentation pages, selected style, and where to preview or publish the site.

best_practices: Review every filesystem and git command before approving it.
Back up important local skills before migration.
Use narrow remote aliases and repository paths that you control.
anti_patterns: Do not grant broad shell permissions without understanding the effect.
Do not migrate unreviewed skills that may contain secrets or private data.
Do not publish generated documentation before checking links and ownership details.

faq.question: Does this skill publish my code automatically?
faq.answer: It can configure git remotes and guide publishing, but remote pushes still depend on approved commands and credentials.

faq.question: Why does it use symlinks?
faq.answer: Symlinks keep Claude Code able to load the skill while the source files live in a repository.

faq.question: Where is configuration stored?
faq.answer: The skill documents configuration in the Claude directory under a share-skill config file.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: The report marks Codex support, but local behavior depends on tool access to filesystem and git commands.

faq.question: Does it support documentation sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes workflows for generating a static documentation site for shared skills.

faq.question: Is it safe to auto-install?
faq.answer: It should be reviewed before use because it requests broad filesystem, git, and Claude settings permissions.
